spec.situation_desc: is frustrated that their branch closed and phone waits are long
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're going through a divorce

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Carys Thornbury. I’m really fed up that you closed our branch, and then I’m left waiting ages when I phone. It’s not good enough.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Carys. I can understand why that’s frustrating, especially when the branch has closed and you’re having trouble getting through.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was the branch I’d used for years. Now every time I need to ask something, I’m stuck on hold.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I hear you. I’ll take ownership of raising this feedback, and I can log it as a complaint so the bank can respond to what you’ve experienced.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, please. I’m already dealing with a divorce, and this is just one more thing to sort out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Would you like me to log the complaint about the branch closure and the phone waiting times?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s exactly what I want.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging this as a complaint now, covering the branch closure and the long waits on the phone. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit it today for our complaints team to review. They’ll look into the points you’ve raised and send you a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And if I don’t hear anything by then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll make sure it’s submitted today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm tomorrow to confirm it’s been passed on and give you the complaint reference. The complaints team will then send the full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so you’re logging it today, you’ll call me tomorrow with the reference, and I’ll get the written response within 8 weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’m logging your complaint about the branch closure and phone waits today, I’ll call by 4 pm tomorrow with the reference, and the complaints team will send a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Carys. I’m sorry again for the frustration, and I’ll make that call tomorrow.
